items.rationale: Covered under 5.2.6(b) assessment costs (cap EUR 3,000), triggered by an insured escape of water from leaking aged pipes (2.4.3). Priced at the prior level of about 524.
Leak location is covered under 5.2.6(a). The EUR 1,000 cap is shared with the technician time on line 3; the combined total stays below the cap.

On-site technician time for leak location is expressly included in 5.2.6(a). It is not a duplicate of line 2 because it is a different measure, and it fits within the remaining part of the EUR 1,000 cap.
One vehicle charge per contractor per invoice is covered under 5.2.6(c), capped at EUR 70 net, i.e. about EUR 83 gross.

items.description: Repair of actively leaking copper joints
items.rationale: Under 2.4.3, leakage from corrosion or ageing counts as fracture damage for the sections shown to be leaking. The two weeping joints are covered at a customary repair price.

items.description: Precautionary replacement of non-leaking copper run
items.rationale: 2.4.3 states that sections not themselves shown to be leaking are not covered. 7.1.5 excludes work on unaffected parts and 7.1.8(a) excludes upkeep measures.
7.1.9 bars improvement on the pre-loss standard, so the upgrade difference is borne by the policyholder.
5.2.6(c) allows one vehicle charge per contractor per invoice for the repair journey, capped at EUR 70 net, i.e. about EUR 83 gross.
